shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OtakuSoul character-card portrait, final crop 700x937. Create one polished vertical anime game character portrait faithful to the canonical default design. Solo centered upper-thigh three-quarter framing, complete head and distinguishing features visible, safe margin for a 3:4 crop. Premium modern anime RPG key art, crisp cel shading blended with a soft painterly finish, understated supernatural urban or dreamlike gradient backdrop. Exactly one main character (plus only the specifically named small companion), adult or young-adult proportions, no text, logo, watermark, UI, or border.

postprocessing: Each generated PNG was center-cropped and resized with ImageMagick to exactly 700x937 pixels.
The complete matching UTF-8 Character Card V2 JSON was Base64-encoded into the PNG tEXt field named chara with Pillow.
Preset and gateway PNGs use the same portrait pixels and the same embedded profile because these cards contain no relative expression paths.
